info.title: Mootz achievement frames
info.description: Offchain achievement policy demo-v1: First Meet 1 Dot, Together 10 Dots, Social Butterfly 5 distinct currently accepted friend partners. Hidden Dots and offchain/failed-chain Meets count. Unlocks persist after unfriend. Historical unlock time is first reconciliation, not inferred achievement time. assetKey is an identifier for FE-provided artwork; artwork delivery is not implemented here. One active frame shared with Event collection equip.

get.summary: Reconcile achievement inventory for authenticated account
get.description: Returns policy {version:demo-v1,status:demo}, metrics {dotCount,distinctFriendPartners}, and items {id,name,assetKey,requirement:{metric,target},progress,unlocked,unlockedAt}. Progress is capped at requirement target. Unlock timestamps use database clock and remain immutable.
Event frame ownership is rechecked against current wallet and contract. Confirmed ownership loss clears own slot. RPC/configuration uncertainty returns 503 and preserves it.

delete.summary: Clear own frame of either source without RPC
